description: Defines the class Smarty_Internal_Method_ClearCompiledTemplate which provides a method to clear compiled templates in Smarty template engine, including logic for deleting cached PHP files and managing template resources.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_ClearCompiledTemplate
classes.description: Class containing a method to delete compiled template files and manage cache invalidation within the Smarty templating system.

methods.name: clearCompiledTemplate
methods.description: Deletes compiled template files, optionally based on resource name, compile id, and expiration time; also manages cache and cache invalidation.
